# wOzy

> wOzy (wOzy Technologies LLC) is a small independent studio that has made iPhone and iPad apps and games since 2010. It started as a small team in Colombia and is still small on purpose.

## Apps

- [Animal Loop](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/): One-tap animal racing game for iPhone (including iPhone Duo), iPad and Mac. 18 racers, 27 handmade tracks across three worlds (Dune Flats, Coral Shallows, Fern Hollow), a Grand Prix in every world and a day/night cycle on every track. Free to download, with in-app purchases. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/animal-loop/id6806081867)
- [TicToe Fury](https://www.wozy.co/tictoefury/): Free 9x9 tic-tac-toe game (also known as ultimate tic-tac-toe) for iPhone and iPad: nine small boards inside one big board, where the square you pick decides which board your opponent plays next. Play the AI, a friend on the same device, or online with Game Center; chalkboard graphics, 30+ achievements and original music. wOzy's first game, launched with the first iPad in 2010; 400,000+ downloads worldwide and a top 10 board game in multiple countries, as of October 2026. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tictoe-fury-tic-tac-toe/id534426331)
- [Odyz](https://www.odyz.app/): Privacy-first travel tracker for iPhone and iPad. Turns the photos on your phone into trips, a 3D map and a digital passport of every country and city you've visited, with a landmark stamp for each place; no account needed, processed on your device. Free to download. Its own site is odyz.app, with its own llms.txt at https://www.odyz.app/llms.txt. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/odyz/id6736624376)
- [Dapply](https://www.wozy.co/dapply/): Free NFT gallery for iPhone with Ethereum and Solana support. Now in demo mode and no longer in full service; Dapply 3.0 preserves collections as a museum of the Web3 era. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dapply/id1601017101)

## Writing

- [Animal Loop dev diary](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/blog/): All posts on how Animal Loop is designed and built. RSS feed: https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/blog/feed.xml
- [Building Frost Valley](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/blog/building-frost-valley/): Coming-soon developer diary on Animal Loop's fourth world, Frost Valley: how its cracking ice works (it breaks behind the racer and freezes back slowly as you race), why it was hard to build (fairness rules, wider roads, memory budgets), progress on its nine tracks, and its rival, the Penguin.
- [Meet Turkey](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/blog/meet-turkey/): The Thanksgiving update brings Animal Loop's first seasonal racer, Turkey. Race on 15 different days in November (any race counts, one per day, days add up every year) to unlock it; the title screen also changes with the seasons.
- [Building Animal Loop](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/blog/building-animal-loop/): Developer diary on how a shelved iPad-era idea became Animal Loop, and the custom track simulator, track analyzer and level editor built to design and balance its 27 tracks.

## Help

- [What is a Grand Prix in Animal Loop?](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/help/what-is-a-grand-prix/): All nine tracks of a world raced back to back at one speed you pick, against that world's rival animal (Armadillo, Puffer or Ladybug); win it and the rival joins your roster
- [How do you play Animal Loop with friends?](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/help/how-to-play-with-friends/): Invite friends through Game Center, race their best runs as ghosts and beat their Grand Prix times
- [How do you play 9x9 tic-tac-toe in TicToe Fury?](https://www.wozy.co/tictoefury/help/how-to-play-9x9-tic-tac-toe/): The rules of 9x9 (ultimate) tic-tac-toe, with a diagram and strategy tips
- [Odyz FAQ](https://www.odyz.app/#faq): How to track your trips, see your travel stats, and see how many and which countries and cities you've visited, each with a step-by-step page

## Comparisons

- [TicToe Fury vs regular tic-tac-toe](https://www.wozy.co/tictoefury/compare/): How TicToe Fury's 9x9 game works and why it beats regular 3x3 tic-tac-toe apps, as of October 2026
- [Animal Loop vs other racing games](https://www.wozy.co/animal-loop/compare/): What Animal Loop does better than Mario Kart Tour (shut down September 2026), one-tap drift games and Super Monkey Ball, and what makes it unique, as of October 2026
- [Odyz vs other travel tracker apps and Apple Photos](https://www.odyz.app/compare/): What Odyz does that other travel tracker apps and Apple Photos don't, as of October 2026
